title: Hybrid Retrieval for Government Scheme Search in English and Marathi
abstract: arXiv:2611.26514v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieving government schemes requires matching citizens' information needs to formal administrative descriptions, often across languages and terminology. We present a bilingual search system for Maharashtra government schemes and public services that combines BM25 retrieval with sentence-embedding similarity through equal-weight score fusion. The system indexes aligned English-Marathi scheme descriptions and supports multilingual, Marathi-focused, and translation-mediated semantic configurations. Evaluation on manually curated bilingual queries compares BM25, dense retrieval, and hybrid retrieval using IndicSBERT and MahaSBERT. BM25 provides a strong baseline with a mean reciprocal rank (MRR) of 0.864. Hybrid retrieval increases MRR to 0.872 with IndicSBERT and 0.879 with MahaSBERT, whereas the corresponding dense-only systems achieve 0.663 and 0.655. translated_title: 英文与马拉地语政府计划搜索的混合检索
translated_abstract: 检索政府计划需要将公民的信息需求与正式的行政描述相匹配，这通常涉及跨语言和跨术语的匹配问题。我们提出了一个针对马哈拉施特拉邦政府计划和公共服务的双语搜索系统，该系统通过等权重分数融合将BM25检索与句子嵌入相似度相结合。该系统对对齐的英语-马拉地语计划描述进行索引，并支持多语言、以马拉地语为主以及翻译中介的语义配置。在人工整理的双语查询上进行评估，使用IndicSBERT和MahaSBERT对BM25、密集检索和混合检索进行了比较。BM25提供了强大的基线，平均倒数排名（MRR）为0.864。混合检索使用IndicSBERT将MRR提升至0.872，使用MahaSBERT提升至0.879，而相应的纯密集检索系统仅达到0.663和0.655。基于MahaSBERT的融合还使精确率从0.781提升至0.808，同时匹配B（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个面向马哈拉施特拉邦政府计划的双语（英语-马拉地语）搜索系统，通过等权重融合BM25与句子嵌入相似度，混合检索显著优于单独的BM25或密集检索，MRR最高达0.879。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a bilingual English-Marathi search system for Maharashtra government schemes that fuses BM25 with sentence-embedding similarity, showing that hybrid retrieval significantly outperforms BM25 and dense-only baselines with an MRR of up to 0.879.
